# Chapter Seven: Past And Present

Rebecca reported back to Sowain, he took the information and put it in his book, A call came in from his contact at Meade, someone had been poking around about Victor and his family, He wasn’t sure who or where as it was coming over burners but he had caught the name and a reference to a kill squad. Sowain had closed his eyes, here we go again, someone was trying to eliminate the line. This was not the first time but it was the first time he would be in a position to do something about it.

“Marcus I need to see you” he said out loud, knowing the wolf hearing was still active as a human. Within moments Marcus was there pulling up a chair. “What’s up boss” he said leaning back and staring at the Alpha. Marcus was next in line for alpha he was strong and capable, even more so he was even handed and could lead well. He was always Sowain’s first choice for a mission, since he had picked him up back in the Civil War during the Jamestown mission. Marcus was also family, He had given him the choice and Marcus had chosen prior to the church getting ahold of him.

Sowain put on the CD player, it didn’t matter what was on but it would disrupt any prying ears for the conversation he was about to have. “Marcus, we have a situation, one of the family is about to get nailed, it looks like they are going for the whole line, I am guessing the wife and kids aren’t exempt either” Sowain said looking at his number 2. Marcus shook his head, Jesus we don’t need this bloodbath shit and kids, what are we animals, I thought the pact took care of this we don’t hunt like that anymore. Marcus was referring to a pact set amongst the American Packs more than 80 years ago which set down the rules of the hunt. This meant only going after stray’s and anyone who themselves were predators, this kept the police off them and also allowed them better movement across the country.

“Someone doesn’t care about the pact, they are going in tonight from what I found out, I need you to take a few of ours and ensure that doesn’t happen, Marcus you know what’s at stake, if you can’t save all of them at least get the kids out” He said looking at his desk, he knew he had just signed a death warrant for Victor and his wife if things got bad, but he didn’t have a choice. Standard rules, do not get seen and for god’s sakes don’t get photographed, we don’t need any more of that shit hitting YouTube. “don’t worry boss I will keep then stealth; we are just lucky that any video someone gets always gets put off as good CGI” turns out those damn books from that lady in Utah did us some good he said smiling. He always got a laugh about that, if she only knew, Sowain leaned back and caught Marcus’s eyes pulling him out of his thoughts. “I need this clean and I need them safe” he said and then dismissed him.

Marcus left the office and went to find Rebecca, he would pull her and then Timothy one of these newer wolves, but he was good at stealth and knew alarm systems being only a few years old as a member of the pack, Marcus was never one for technology but it was part of the mortal world and would have to be dealt with lest the cops show up and find three big man wolves running around a suburb of DC. That wouldn’t bode well for anyone.

He found Patricia instead waiting outside Sowain’s door “Listening in again are we?” he asked mildly annoyed, she was way too curious for her own good sometimes and it could be annoying. “Not really just wondering what all the super-secret stuff going on today was that’s all” she said blocking the hallway. She was Blonde and a little stocky, similar to a gymnast but she was one of the best trackers they had, the boss had picked her up from a Circus in Boston around 1910 and she had been quite the boon it turned out. But as with anything she could be a pain in the ass when she wasn’t allowed into the loop Marcus just sighed “don’t worry, its old business and a little clean up that’s all, so if you don’t mind I have orders, do me a favor and stick around the house tonight, I need someone here watching the place” he said giving her a look that she knew meant he had a bad feeling. Patricia straightened up “Got it, anything particular or just make sure the doors are locked and the cat is in” using an old Wolf Joke, Animals and pets especially did not like their kind and would go nuts in their presence, no one was actually sure what it was, but there was some theories about a former predator sensing another or some such shit. “Just keep an eye, I don’t think it will be bad, but just something isn’t right” he said putting a hand on her shoulder for emphasis, she was small next to his 6 foot 3 bulky Georgia farm boy frame. Patricia nodded and walked back towards her room.

The house was an old 1900’s Victorian, one of several houses around the country the pack owned, allowing them the ability to go to ground or settle in as needed. It was bought by Sowain but under a different name, it was owned by a property company as were all their safe houses. It had more than enough room for the pack and the yard and fence offered an abundance of privacy. It was maintained regular by a company that was on contract to the property company and called off when the pack was here. This way no unfortunate incidents occurred like a gardener coming across someone in the middle of a chance, that had actually happened before and it was not an easy thing to deal with. Add cellphones and the fact that every single person on the planet had the ability to record or take photo’s at will and that made it more difficult. Thing were so much easier prior to the 90’s he thought to himself, walking down he hardwood hallway of the big house.

He found Rebecca and Timothy in the TV room watching some reality show or another, they loved their TV and always dv’rd some episode, it got so bad that any property they owned always had a full drive of some crap they liked to watch. Marcus walked in the room grabbing the remote and shutting off the TV, this of course garnered grumbles and protest from two on the couch, they had developed a comfortable brother/sister relationship over the years and usually could be found together doing something or getting into trouble, depending on how bored they were.

“I need you two tonight, we have a mission, Rebecca knows the location and I will fill you in when we leave, it will be a non-human incursion” he said, letting them know to leave anything but the bare clothes home. We have a few hours before we leave, but be in the garage at 7 on the dot” Marcus hit the button on the remote and the TV went back to the show they were watching.

Marcus left the room and just about ran straight into Brock who was lurking in the hall, probably listening like he liked to do, he was a weasel but had his uses, there was no one better at fixing an engine then Brock. “Hey boss, sounds like a busy night, need me for anything?” he asked innocently. Marcus just looked at the man, he was about 4 inches shorter and his long brown hair had not changed since the 70’s despite fashion trends. It always seemed to look unwashed no matter what he used. “Check the bikes while we are gone, Patricia is in charge if the Boss doesn’t make himself present, other than that, stay out of trouble” he said pushing his way past the other wolf. “NO problem boss, I’ll get right on it” Brock said a little too enthusiastic, Marcus ignored it for now but something was off about the other man Marcus could feel it, he was anxious about something, just not sure what.

Patricia

Patricia watched as Marcus pushed past Brock and the look Brock gave him as he did, Marcus may not have time to deal with him, but Patricia definitely did, she knew he had gone out and returned a little before Rebecca did, Brock had been on edge all day, she could see it and it bugged her. He had tried to get into the pants of every female in the pack and been shot down accordingly. She continued to watch as he walked into the bathroom and then could distinctly here the water running. She focused her ears and she heard the sound of tones as he dialed a cell phone “hmm and the plot thickens” she thought, She tried to get a read on the voice but the water kept cutting in, she wasn’t as good as some at focusing her hearing to tune out sounds, but she knew he was up to something, she would have to watch him tonight, carefully.

She was as old as some of the others but she had her talents and sniffing out things that were definitely not right was one of them. There was no coincidence that Marcus was going on a mission and Brock was interested in finding out more, then the phone call. There was a double cross going on here, she knew it. It would not be the first time she suspected the other wolf in playing outside the pack for favors. But proving it was another thing, the man had a gift for ensuring nothing landed on his back. Like back in 1960 the deaths of 4 showgirls, He had come back to the Nevada house covered in blood but had managed to explain it away enough where Sowain didn’t lift a finger, she still didn’t know what the hell he had said to buy his way out of that one.

But if he was looking to put a double-cross onto Marcus and the group, he had another thing coming. Patricia walked out into the yard and left the property heading up the street at a leisurely pace, once she knew she was out of earshot of anyone in the house she opened her cell phone and punched a number. It was one she had used only a few times and she didn’t like it, but they had there uses as did anyone. “What do you want Patricia” said the old voice on the other end. Patricia sighed “You know that guy you guys poached earlier from the Park Police, well let’s just say there is some interest in him and I think some of it not good, we are sending some of our people out tonight and from the group it looks like a protection detail, I would pay special attention to him if I were you” and then she hung up.

She like all wolves hated the order, but she hated wolves who broke the pack more, she had seen the aftermath of a wolf who decided to give in to his animal half, and it had bothered her even to this day. Children broken and tore apart, strewn around a house and flashes of mothers with their bellies torn open so the wolf could get to the tender baby inside. She shivered, she had never had children but she was a protective person by nature children were off limits and she would ensure that whatever happened they were protected. She had no love for humans in general, but those that couldn’t protect themselves needed to be protected and she would ensure that was the case, even if it meant dealing with those monsters.

She walked back to the house, the call done she had a mission of her own and with Brock still in residence she would have her hands full. She reached the front gate and was walking towards the house and then the world turned sideways as the house exploded outwards.
